buyer.notes: on projects (secondary and the official fees page snippet)

fees.notes: Fixed-price projects pay 10% or 5 USD, whichever is greater, and hourly projects 10% (official fees page, read 2026-10-25). The 5 USD minimum is not modeled, so a project under 50 USD nets less than the price table says. Taxes on fees apply only to residents of the countries the page lists (Australia, Chile, the EU, India, Mexico, the Philippines, Russia, Switzerland), and Korea is not one of them. Withdrawals cost 1 USD (express, PayPal, Skrill, Payoneer) or 25 USD (wire) each with a 50 USD minimum, outside any one project. Payments beyond the winning bid add 3% client and 10% freelancer.

bidCost.notes: Free with a monthly limit: Free 6, Basic 50, Plus 100, Professional 300, Premier 1500 (official FAQ). Placing any bid needs an available account balance of at least 20 USD (official fees page). Observed 2026-10-27 on the free plan: the self API counts 6 bids left of 6 (account_balances.bids_remaining), and every project page withholds the bid form behind a banner asking for the 20 USD balance (Add Funds) and three steps (Update your skills, Verify your email, Update your profile).

contactPolicy.notes: Members communicate only through the website's own features (Code of Conduct), and posting contact information or links to contact information in a project description, a bid or on the message boards is the most common reason Freelancer gives for project removal and account suspension (FAQ, Why is my account suspended?, read 2026-10-28). No contact class is released before or after an order.

onboardingPacing.notes: fsw onboard walks the signup wizard once at a person's pace: a 2.5 to 6 s gap before each action, keys typed 80 to 220 ms apart, page loads 20 s apart and at most one run per 30 minutes. On 2026-10-26 the site signed the operator out after scripts drove its wizard at machine speed. No message is sent.
